customers_say: Customers find the digital lock functions well and provides good home security, with one noting it works well on wooden doors. They appreciate its features, with one highlighting its multiple unlocking options, and consider it a helpful addition to their homes. The installation and service receive positive feedback, with one mentioning well-trained technicians. While some customers consider it good value for the price, others find it costly. The connectivity aspect receives mixed reviews, with several customers reporting connection issues.

reviews.author: Dripta T.
reviews.title: Review Godrej Neo Pro digital Lick
reviews.body: The product was delivered with open box installation without any issue. Booked the installation separately from Godrej. It was free of charge and installation has been done on the same day. The installation process was seamless and the technician explained everything well. I’ve been using this lock for more than a month and I don’t see any significant issue so far. The only problem is that the bell sound is almost inaudible and it is difficult to find.
